verdict.rationale: Paystack's own API docs say multiple currencies are supported in some markets, each with its own fees and minimums. That gives limited, market-dependent multi-currency charging. Nothing in the pack covers settling to the founder's bank in a different currency or how FX conversion is handled or disclosed. Missing for 10: cross-currency settlement to the merchant's home currency, transparent FX rate/conversion documentation, list of supported currencies/markets, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: In some markets, multiple currencies are supported each with their own transaction fees and minimum amounts.
